title: DecisionEntry
description: Records a significant architectural or technical decision made during planning. Append-only — entries are never modified, only superseded. Planner records decisions for technology, architecture, data store, protocol, security, and deployment choices.

id.description: Unique decision ID. Format: DEC-NNNN, zero-padded to 4 digits. Assigned sequentially per pipeline run. Immutable once set.

decision_type.description: Category of decision. Must be one of the defined types for indexability and query support.

title.description: Short title for this decision. E.g. 'Select primary database engine'.

context.description: What problem or situation prompted this decision. Include constraints and forces in play.

options.description: All alternatives considered. Minimum 2 options required — single-option decisions are rejected.

selected.description: True for the chosen option. Exactly one option must have selected: true per DecisionEntry.

decision.description: The label of the chosen option. Must match exactly one options[].label where selected: true.

rationale.description: Why this option was chosen over the alternatives. Must be substantive.

trade_offs.description: Accepted downsides or risks of the chosen option.

ref.description: Artifact ID, URL, or descriptive reference string.

description.description: Optional context for this evidence item.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence: benchmarks, research artifacts, regulatory requirements, precedents.

decided_by.description: Who or what made this decision. For planner: 'feature-planning'. For human: 'hitl:{identifier}'. For consensus: 'consensus:{agent_a}+{agent_b}'.

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was made.

supersedes.description: ID of the prior DecisionEntry this entry supersedes. The superseded entry remains in the log — never deleted. Null if this is an original decision.

superseded_by.description: ID of the DecisionEntry that supersedes this one. Null if this decision is still active. Set by the decision log manager when a newer decision is recorded.

affected_sections.description: Plan section IDs impacted by this decision.

affected_contract_ids.description: UUIDs of implementation contracts that reference this decision.
